standing_invariants: npm test, npm run lint, npx tsc -b, npm run build:store all pass on every commit
static/offline only — no network, no runtime AI, no new dependencies
never weaken a test to pass content; fix the content
never change lesson narration unless task is a new lesson step (+B6 tts flow)
original content only; kid-safe (7-9, child-directed); when unsure about a fact, leave it out
US spelling, serial comma, spelled-out labels, no standards codes/dev words in kid-facing copy
answers exact members of options; >30% longest / >35% shortest answer ratio fails answerBias — vary lengths
variety rule: any batch of 10, no name/setting more than twice
commit format: Content: +N <bank> L<level> (<theme words>) — ledger committed together with content
motion (if touched): no filters, motion ends within 1-2s of cue, ~150 elements, Paper bg, deterministic rand(i), reduced handled
